Package org.clafer.ig

package org.clafer.ig
This package provides the solution loop shared by the backends, a port of claferIG's command line: the REPL, the solutions (the instances of a static model from Choco, or the traces of a temporal model from Alloy) and their views.
  • Class
    Description
    Backend
    A solver of a model behind the solution loop (Repl): Choco for a static model, whose solutions are instances, and Alloy for a temporal model, whose solutions are traces.
    Backend.Shown
    A solution as it is shown, with Alloy's XML of it, if any.
    ClaferModel
    An instance of a model, as claferIG's ClaferModel.hs has it: its top-level clafers, each with its children.
    ClaferModel.AliasValue
     
    ClaferModel.Clafer
    An instance of a clafer: its name, the UID of its clafer, its value (or null) and its children.
    ClaferModel.Id
    The tuple of name and ordinal is globally unique.
    ClaferModel.IntValue
     
    ClaferModel.StringValue
     
    ClaferModel.Value
    The value of a clafer: a clafer it refers to, an integer or a string.
    Repl
    The one loop of the solutions, whatever the backend: claferIG's CommandLine.hs, with clafersg's commands.
    Repl.Context
    The solutions shown so far, the most recent first: those not saved yet and those saved; the Alloy XML of the most recent; and whether they are shown as the changes from the previous snapshot.
    Repl.Displayer
    Shows a solution, which becomes the most recent one.
    Repl.Io
    The input of the commands and the outputs: claferIG prints its solutions on the standard output and its unsat cores on the standard error.
    Solution
    A solution of a model, claferIG's ClaferSolution: an instance of a static model, or a trace of a dynamic model, whose states are instances, with the state to which its last state loops back.
    Solution.Instance
    An instance, with its text as its backend prints it, if the backend prints it otherwise than claferIG (null for claferIG's text).
    Solution.Trace
     
    SolutionView
    The views of the solutions, claferIG's SolutionView.hs: a static model has instances, and a dynamic model has traces, whose states are instances.
